couches._lisez_moi: Chimera's layers: garment types, kinds of accessories, ranks (what goes over what), stacking thresholds. Public values, read after reglages.defaut.json. Do not change them here: write in reglages.json, under "couches", only the keys to change (merged key by key; a list is replaced whole). See outils/atelier/README.md, the section on tuning the layers.

vetements._aide: garment type (the one in fiche.json) -> tab of the page (haut, bas, chaussures, accessoires: the page knows only these), slot (two parts with the same slot are not worn together), rank (from inside to outside: the smallest is worn underneath), displayed name, occupe (slots it takes in addition to its own). A type missing from here does not enter the catalogue.

accessoires._aide: kind of accessory (the one in fiche.json) -> rank, exclusive (only one of this kind at a time), displayed name, comme_ceinture (goes around the body: fitted with the clothes, laid on the fabric without ever squeezing it; the other accessories are laid over what they touch). Tab: always accessoires. A kind missing from here does not enter the catalogue.

tenue._aide: Rules of a worn outfit (outils/atelier/combinaison.py). rangs_dans_la_tenue: rank forced on a type during fitting, instead of its own (a belt is worn over the bottom and under the open jacket). bas_fermes: the bottoms that cover the underwear (it is then not worn). hauts and bas: a top whose hem comes out of the bottom by more than ordre_dehors_mm is worn over that bottom.

_aide.marge_accessoire_mm: gap between a laid accessory (necklace, bag) and what it touches
_aide.marge_entre_couches_mm: gap between two layers, along a line (more for wide meshes, see fleche_max_mm)
_aide.plancher_mm: height above the skin below which a part is not crushed (except under a boot)
_aide.pan_libre_mm: a free flap (skirt hem, frill) farther than this in front of the outer part flares over it and is left untouched; it is also the most a belt sticks out
_aide.sortie_max_mm: an outer part never moves out by more than this (a jacket does not puff up); the rest is reported
_aide.rayon_membre_mm: curvature of a limb: an edge of length e deviates from it by e² / (8 × radius), added to the gap between layers
_aide.fleche_max_mm: the most that the edge length adds to the gap between layers
_aide.ordre_dehors_mm: median protrusion of a top out of the bottom from which the top is worn over it
_aide.tolerance_masque_mm: an inner face is hidden (removed) if it is under the outer part, or in front of it by less than this
_aide.portee_masque_mm: beyond this, the outer part floats: you see underneath through the opening, nothing is removed
_aide.portee_rayon_mm: beyond this, two parts are no longer on top of each other (length of the measuring rays; longer = slower)
_aide.signal_profondeur_mm: an inner point that passes in front of the outer part by more than this counts as poking through
_aide.signal_part: share of poking-through points (0.01 = 1 %) from which the page flags a pair
_aide.passes: fitting passes per part (more = slower, recovers difficult parts better)
